::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 25th 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear [Mr Warden](people/person_1304.qmd)

Thank you much for your kind reply. I hope to appear with my maid by the train that reaches Oxford at 4.25, when I think I arrive just in time for chapel. I have just got a card for [Mrs Talbot](people/person_2082.qmd)’s evening party that night.

I am afraid I cannot stay after Saturday as I am engaged to spend Sunday at the Deanery at St Pauls.[^1]

With all thanks and kind regards to [Miss Sewell](people/person_1305.qmd).
Yours very sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: The Dean of St. Paul's was the Very Rev. [Richard William Church](people/person_297.qmd).
